definitions.explanation: A spicy, aromatic root used as a flavoring and in traditional medicine.

examples.japanese: {生姜|しょうが}をすりおろす。
{生姜|しょうが}{焼|や}きを{作|つく}る。
{風邪|かぜ}の{時|とき}は{生姜|しょうが}{湯|ゆ}を{飲|の}む。
examples.english: I drink ginger tea when I have a cold.

notes:
{生姜|しょうが} is widely used in Japanese cuisine and traditional medicine.

COMMON USES:
- {生姜|しょうが}{焼|や}き: ginger pork (popular dish)
- おろし{生姜|しょうが}: grated ginger
- {紅|べに}{生姜|しょうが}: pickled red ginger
- ガリ: pickled ginger (served with sushi)
- {生姜|しょうが}{湯|ゆ}: ginger tea

HEALTH: Believed to warm the body and help with colds and digestion.
